Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 2471/2019

Dear Ms. Bansal,

Thank you for meeting us on 22 February 2020 about your dispute with Mohan Rane. As we understand it, the couple has a young child. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Kozhikode.

Our advice is to agree a joint parenting plan before the second motion. Please collect the school records of the child and the draft parenting plan and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
